svg.title: kNN relation schematic
svg.desc: Scattered points in a plane. One query point is highlighted; its three nearest neighbors sit inside a dashed circle and each sends a weighted message into it. All other points are ignored.
svg.text: kNN graph: each point links to its k closest neighbors
schematic with k = 3 · example runs N = 1024 points in 3-D, k = 16, weights all 1
